configuration.initialization_ablation: Only output kernel changes: N(0,0.001), numpy seed 2026; bias zero
configuration.paired_training: Every neural candidate has identical seed, row order and batch order
configuration.scalar_control: Mean normalized train target minus raw frozen baseline; no validation fit
configuration.diagnostic_protocol: Fixed train sample, gradient batch and known validation IDs across candidates
configuration.prediction_convention: Train raw normalized MSE plus L2; validation clipped to ratings 1–10
configuration.checkpoint_protocol: Network+Adam+RNG each epoch; immutable backup every 2 epochs and completion
configuration.test_policy: Test CSV prohibited in input directory; no test metrics computed

dataset.split_policy: Unchanged previous user/work holdout and train-only catalog

limitations: One seed and only 140 known validation pairs on a previously used development split.

Controls use fixed train-derived biases; scalar is fitted on train only.
